headline.purpose: Section anchors and high-emphasis product statements.

title.purpose: Cards, sections, and medium-emphasis UI groupings.

label.purpose: Buttons, chips, and compact interaction language.

working-lift.purpose: App bars, snackbars, dialogs, and task-critical layer separation.

action-lift.purpose: Floating actions and stronger interactive emphasis.

motion.principle: Motion should clarify state and conversion emphasis, never decorate task flow.

dos: Keep utility surfaces calm and readable with one clear primary action.
Use premium amber only in monetization, premium, or reward contexts.
Increase conversion emphasis through hierarchy and proof, not visual noise.
donts: Do not style the app like a heavy finance dashboard.
Do not use generic AI hype or futuristic spectacle as the conversion strategy.
Do not create noisy paywalls with too many competing highlights.

weightConventions.rule: Never use PhosphorIcons.name(style) syntax — disables tree shaking.

stateConventions.navigationBar: Regular for icon:, Fill for selectedIcon: — same geometry, heavier weight signals selection.
stateConventions.toggles: Regular when off, Fill when on.
stateConventions.premiumBadges: Fill for crown, star in monetization surfaces.
stateConventions.thumbs: PhosphorIconsFill.thumbsUp/Down for voted state, Regular otherwise.

frozenMaterialFiles.reason: These 4 files store icon codePoints directly in Firestore. Switching to Phosphor codePoints would silently corrupt existing user category and meal-type icons.
frozenMaterialFiles.migrationPath: Store font-family alongside codePoint in Firestore schema, add Phosphor entries to _iconMap in both model files, then update picker UIs. Requires a one-time data migration for existing users.
